description: Queue any event on the computer, as os.queueEvent would, and return "ok" at once. Use it for events nothing else produces, e.g. name 'timer' with params [3], or 'redstone'. For keys, typing and touches use craftos_act; to change the world itself (redstone input, items, players) use craftos_sim_command. Follow with craftos_settle to let the program react.

name.description: Event name, the first value os.pullEvent returns.

params.description: The event's other values, in order.

name: craftos_send_event
